1: Chapter 1: The Visitor on a Rainy Night

It had been raining in Qingshi for three days straight. Lin Xiaoyu's older sister had gone to the capital in the spring, and since then Lin Xiaoyu had been left to look after the little medicine shop in town by herself.
After dark, she closed the doors and windows, counted the day's takings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
She had just lain down when an urgent knocking came from downstairs, followed by a man's voice: "Is anyone there?"
Outside the door stood a young man soaked to the skin, a blood-stained cloth wrapped around his left arm. He said his name was Bai Yun and that he was with the Azure Dragon Society.
"I need my wound dressed," Bai Yun said in a low voice. "I can pay. Is three thousand five hundred wen enough?"
He took a letter wrapped in oilpaper from inside his robe. "This letter must be delivered to Qingfeng before May eighteenth."
As she bandaged him, he said with a wry smile, "If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a young woman's door in the middle of the night, she'd be jealous."
Lin Xiaoyu didn't take his money. She just said, "I'll take you up the mountain first thing tomorrow morning."
2: At first light, the two set out. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back with dry rations, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella inside.

Halfway up the mountain they ran into the old woodcutter Zhou Dashan. The old man set down his axe and lowered his voice to say that the previous evening three out-of-towners had been asking around at the entrance to the town about an injured young man.
"Xiaoyu, take the small trail," Zhou Dashan said. "The main road isn't safe." Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The trail was narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu walked in front, placing each step steadily. Bai Yun followed behind without saying a word.

By noon the rain had stopped, the mist in the mountains slowly cleared, and in the distance the rooftops of Qingfeng appeared. At the temple gate stood a nun named Zhao Qiuyue, the guest prefect in charge of receiving visitors.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, glanced at the red seal on it, and nodded. "The abbot has been waiting 2 years for this letter."
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, "I owe you my life." Lin Xiaoyu smiled. "Then next time you come, help me fix the roof of the pharmacy." Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
In the evening, Lin Xiaoyu went down the mountain alone. By the time she got home it was already dark. She lit the lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
